notes:
- Updates: opening the app twice in a row no longer throws away an update that works.
- Graphics cards under 7 GB: Whisper gives its memory back after speech-to-text – the video no longer freezes while the sound keeps playing.
- Speech recognition: new Whisper "large-v3-turbo" – almost as good as large-v3, faster and uses less graphics memory.
- Speech recognition: new Fun-ASR-Nano for Chinese (VoxCPM engine) – the most accurate in our tests; long speech is cut into short sentence lines.
- VoxCPM: the engine is found next to the app by itself, even when the saved place is gone.
